subject.title: Allow before_agent_start hooks to override prompt

question: Should trusted code plugins be allowed to replace the current user prompt, and if so what precedence, transcript, and cross-harness contract should OpenClaw guarantee?
rationale: This expands plugin authority from additive context injection to silent replacement of user intent, and the safe behavior cannot be inferred mechanically for competing plugins, persisted transcripts, retries, or runtime parity.

options.title: Approve a gated canonical field
options.body: Add prompt replacement to before_prompt_build, enforce allowPromptInjection, define higher-priority-first precedence, preserve the original transcript, and require embedded PI, CLI, and Codex parity tests.

options.title: Keep prompt hooks additive-only
options.body: Reject replacement authority and address oversized current prompts through core-owned input budgeting or a separately designed context-engine boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve a gated canonical field
recommendation.body: Add prompt replacement to before_prompt_build, enforce allowPromptInjection, define higher-priority-first precedence, preserve the original transcript, and require embedded PI, CLI, and Codex parity tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest merged history spanning the shared prompt-hook contract and the Codex harness parity needed for the decision.
